people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

translations.web: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
translations.bsb: So He will give Israel over on account of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit.”
translations.kjv: And he shall give ➔ Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
translations.asv: And he will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he hath sinned, and wherewith he hath made Israel to sin.
